errors.description: Aspect ratio overshot. The drawn marker measures 151 wide by 122 deep on the left bag and 148 by 125 on the right - about 1.2:1 landscape. The rendered patches are 153 by 80 and 145 by 77 - about 1.9:1. The previous attempt was near-square; this one has gone past the drawn 1.2:1 into markedly shallow.
errors.expected: A gently landscape rectangle about 1.2 times as wide as it is deep
errors.actual: A shallow band about 1.9 times as wide as deep
errors.correction: Render each watch pocket as a rectangle whose depth is about FOUR FIFTHS of its width - a ratio of 1.2 to 1, not a shallow slot - so it reads as a substantial squared-off pouch with real depth.

errors.description: Patch depth normalised to bag depth. Drawing: 126px patch against a 630px bag, ratio 0.20. Render: about 80px against about 600px, ratio 0.13. Patch area relative to bag area is 0.076 rendered against 0.129 drawn, so the patch covers about 60 percent of the relative area it should.
errors.expected: Patch depth about one fifth of the bag's total depth
errors.actual: About one eighth of bag depth
errors.correction: Deepen each patch so its top edge sits at roughly three quarters of the way down the bag while its bottom edge stays where it is, restoring the drawn one-fifth-of-bag-depth proportion.

errors.description: Horizontal seat on the bag. Drawing places the patch from 26 to 91 percent of bag width measured from the outer edge, centre at 58 percent - inboard-biased with its inner edge nearly on the bag's inboard edge. Render places it 20 to 77 percent, centre 49 - effectively centred.
errors.expected: Patch biased inboard, inner edge running almost to the bag's inboard edge
errors.correction: Slide each patch inboard so its inner edge finishes within a hair of the bag's inboard edge, leaving the spare bag width outboard.

errors.description: The small dark dots at the bag tops and along the fly render as hard metallic studs. The drawing shows filled dots in the same positions, which in a factory line drawing denote BAR TACKS, not hardware.
errors.expected: Small thread reinforcement marks at the bag corners and fly stations
errors.actual: Dark round dots reading as metal studs
errors.correction: Render these as short dense thread bar tacks in matching pocketing thread, worked flat into the cloth at the bag corners and fly stations.

notes:
Half fixed, half not, so recorded as NOT fixed. Fixed: vertical placement now matches the drawing. Not fixed: the proportional error persists with its sign flipped.

THE LESSON, and it is general. The previous correction told the model to make the patch 'a shallow horizontal rectangle'. The drawing is only 1.2:1 - mild landscape. The model obeyed the ADJECTIVE and produced 1.9:1. An adjective has no scale; a ratio does. Corrections must carry the measured ratio, not a word describing it. This is the same failure as naming an option '68 degrees' and having the model render a 68-degree notch: the model follows what it is told, exactly, so what it is told must be measured.

NOT measurable: any centimetre dimension - the drawing carries no callouts, so all figures are ratios against bag width and depth, both traceable unambiguously in each image.
